answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on invitation quota tree, revoked by a single upheld challenge, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. A ledge of per-task receipts records who did what, and the yarrow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. By the crystal of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
